item.title: Good Morning Family - 19 June 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Friday, the 19 June.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 8 degrees and a top of 12 degrees.
There is about a 94 percent chance of rain.
You might need a raincoat today.
It’s Friday dance party day! Make sure you have a little wiggle today!
. . . . . . . . .
